goal: Prevents spent coins from reappearing as locked after restarting the wallet
Ensures upgrading a temporary lock to a persistent lock clears cleanly when the coin is spent
agreement: Concept approval and verified working as expected through manual testing (vicjuma)
Suggested using insert_or_assign instead of setting fields on failed emplacement (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it resolves an edge-case inconsistency in wallet lock persistence across restarts
The bug causes confusing state for wallet users but does not risk funds or wallet security
